titre: Two knights can't checkmate. Unless Black has a pawn? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Two knights alone can't force mate against a lone king. Give Black a pawn and they can: 1.Kc7! a5 2.Nc6 a4 3.Nd5 a3 4.Nb6#. Without the pawn, 3.Nd5 would be stalemate. Composed position, mate in 4 checked move by move (python-chess + Stockfish 16). Would you have found Kc7? 👇

Analyze your own game, free: https://blundercheck.app/try?src=youtube-en
